title: SEBI Proposes 'GARUDA' Green-Channel Mechanism for Fast-Track AIF Rollout
summary: SEBI proposes GARUDA mechanism allowing Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) to launch schemes within 10 working days of filing placement memorandum.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 SEBI Proposes 'GARUDA' Green-Channel Mechanism for Fast-Track AIF Rollout. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: SEBI issued a proposal for **GARUDA (Green-Channel: AIF Rollout Upon Document Acknowledgement)**, reducing scheme launch timeline from 30 days to 10 working days for AIFs.
